title: Nvidia and Mercedes-Benz Expand Partnership for Level 4 Robolimousines
summary:
MB.OS software will run on Nvidia's Hyperion computers and sensors to power new automated driving and parking functions. This integration adds the Alpamayo software stack for urban navigation and the Halos system for backup safety, forming a comprehensive architecture for driver assistance and city driving.

Nvidia and Mercedes-Benz announced the expansion of their strategic partnership on Oct. 16 to support SAE-Level 4 autonomy. The companies intend to use the technology to create "robolimousines," aiming to combine full autonomous capabilities with the safety and brand standards of the Mercedes luxury line.
